verdict.rationale: Puzzle's AI Close documents AI agents that review transactions and surface discrepancies during month-end close, which directly covers agent-driven ledger review before the close. The evidence never names spend-anomaly or duplicate-transaction detection, and never shows continuous monitoring outside the close workflow. Missing for 10: explicit spend-anomaly flagging, explicit duplicate-transaction detection, ongoing/continuous monitoring rather than a close-time review, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor the ledger and flag anomalies in spend or duplicate transactions before the close

citations.quote: AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
Puzzle's MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration lets you connect your Puzzle account directly to Claude, giving you instant access to your financial data through natural conversation
